items.title: Percy Humphrey Band: Percy Humphrey, Jim Robinson, Ernest Roubleau, Josiah Frazier Interview, 1972-02-29
items.q: The old Vera between Boeben and St. Anthony.

ctx.x: And give you a good funeral to them.

Yeah, when you lose your members, your dead members, you'll be taxed. Some of them 50 cents. Now my daddy belongs to the Prosperity. Used to be that, you remember the old, Hall and Vera, Brother Hall's Church there. The old Vera between Boeben and St. Anthony. Preservative? That's where that would be Brother Hall's Church. The Prosperity Society used to meet there. And that's the name that used to be the way prior to that. And I belong to young men back in New Jersey. That's the way around the night ward. They…

Look at the fuel cost here now. Four and five, $6,000. You got a bear person in, save what? $50 in. Big fuel, isn't it? Look at the cost here now. That's true. You got to go in the thousand now. This is the bear person now. Oh, yeah.
